note: OMIM #621390 explicitly delineates facial dysmorphism and behavioral abnormalities alongside early-onset seizures in KLHL20 disease, supporting this phenotypic combination as a discriminating feature.

evidence.text: KLHL20 is identified as a causative gene for a rare neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by intellectual disability, behavioral problems, and facial dysmorphism.

source.title: MOLECULAR DIAGNOSTICS IN AUTISM SPECTRUM DISORDER: NEXT GENERATION SEQUENCING AND FACIAL PHENOTYPING IN MEDICAL GENETICS
